source_backed_claims.claim: Unknown formats silently return without validation in the library; a nonthrowing FormatChecker by itself does not establish that optional checks ran.

The normal format validator delegates to provided FormatChecker.check and yields library FormatError as a validation error. RecordingChecker delegates super().check unchanged rather than replacing validation algorithms.
idn-email uses the built-in basic @ check; missing idna distribution is not proof that this checker is absent.
iri/iri-reference use optional rfc3987 or rfc3987_syntax; date-time uses optional rfc3339_validator; actual registry still requires runtime observation.
Explicit Registry defaults retrieve to _fail_to_retrieve, which raises NoSuchResource; only retained official resources and library specifications are supplied.

schema_engine_research.planned_format_handling: Original validator class; record encountered FormatChecker.check calls then delegate unchanged. A valid iter_errors traversal is exhausted to None. Registered/encountered/missing are retained, cumulative across graphs. Failure records only the observed prefix/graph, never claims full validation. Encountered-but-unregistered keywords make success impossible.
